findings.text: The comparison goes through UnixNano() on both values. UnixNano is undefined for times outside about 1678–2262, and it overflows int64 there. For example, Greater(t, time.Time{}, someTimeIn1600) or Less with year 0001 versus year 3000 compares wrapped values and gives the wrong ordering, so assertions pass or fail incorrectly. Comparing seconds and then nanoseconds, or using time.Compare, would avoid the overflow.
